recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, symmetrical studio shot of a navy blue school blazer with red piping, featuring a white button-down shirt and a red-and-navy diagonally striped tie. The composition is anchored by a circular lapel pin and an embroidered crest on the pocket, with bold, sans-serif typography layered over the lower-left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Red piping framing the navy blue textile
Diagonal tie stripes contrasting with vertical shirt placket
Circular lapel pin balancing the rectangular pocket crest
Heavy white typography overlapping the dark blazer fabric
coreInvariants: Bright red piping along lapels and pockets
White oxford shirt with visible collar buttons
Diagonal striped tie in matching red and navy

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered on the chest and lapels of a torso-only figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The knot of the tie at the top center and the circular pin on the right lapel.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the tie knot, follow the red piping down to the pocket crest, then move left to the large typographic block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark navy blazer acts as a dense background for the bright white and yellow text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Navy blue (blazer and tie stripes) providing a dark, formal base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright red (piping and tie stripes) providing structural definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden yellow (lapel pin and bottom text line) for highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark navy and the stark white shirt and typography.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning with overlapping characters in the primary wordmark
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'g' with a perfectly circular bowl and a short, curved descender
Lowercase 'e' with a horizontal crossbar and wide aperture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different weights, sizes, and colors to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Circular lapel pin with bird motif

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and tight kerning capability.
Classic geometric sans-serif that fits the collegiate aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a navy blue wool blazer with bright red piping on the lapels and pocket. The blazer is worn over a white button-down oxford shirt and a red and navy diagonally striped tie. A small circular pin with a bird illustration is on the right lapel, and a red embroidered crest is on the pocket. The lighting is even and professional.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three levels of text in the lower-left corner. The middle level is the largest, in bold white lowercase geometric sans-serif with tight kerning. The top level is smaller white text. The bottom level is medium-sized golden yellow text.

verificationChecks: Is the red piping vibrant and sharp?
Is the typography lowercase and geometric?
Is the color palette strictly navy, red, white, and gold?

adjustableVariables: Specific motif on the lapel pin
mustRedesign: Specific bird illustration on the pin
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red piping follows the lapel edge accurately.
Check that the white shirt collar buttons are visible.
Verify the text is left-aligned and stacked vertically.
Confirm the navy blue is deep and saturated.
recipe.reuseFormula: Collegiate Uniform + Geometric Typography + High Contrast Color Blocking
